activity_summary: At her board the loaf was a finger short of the notch. You paid threepence. Firing and washing were named at sixpence the week until Lady Day, and not taken. Nothing went to the Bell. The sentence to Anne stayed on the desk. Supper is at the Burbages'.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid threepence, left the sentence unsent, and said nothing was going to the Bell.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Served the short loaf, named the sixpence, and would not take it off the plate.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked whether the paper went to the Bell.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Stayed on the settle and did not speak.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf is a finger short of the notch, and it has been so since the turn of the year

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Firing and washing are sixpence the week until Lady Day, and I am not taking them off this plate;
